description.en: Start with folders and sprites, then complete an importable two-vehicle mod

title.zh: 从一个能导入的项目开始

summary.zh: 认识模组目录、单位文件和贴图，完成第一次导入
summary.en: Understand the folder, unit files and sprites, then import your first mod

title.zh: 下载后先看目录

body.zh: 下载巡逻双车组并解压一份副本，mod-info.txt 负责在模组列表中显示名称，units 文件夹放车辆配置和图片，压缩包根目录应直接看到 mod-info.txt，避免在外面再套一层同名文件夹
body.en: Download Patrol Pair and extract a working copy, mod-info.txt names the project in the mod list, while units contains the configurations and images, keep mod-info.txt at the archive root

sections.code:
01-patrol-pair/
├─ mod-info.txt
└─ units/
   ├─ scout.ini
   ├─ guard.ini
   ├─ body.png
   ├─ guard.png
   └─ turret.png

title.zh: 给模组取一个能认出的名字
title.en: Give the mod a recognizable title

body.zh: 用 UTF-8 文本编辑器打开 mod-info.txt，先改 title，保留最低版本 1.15，description 适合用一句话说明玩家会得到什么单位，不要把单位配置放进这个文件
body.en: Open mod-info.txt in a UTF-8 text editor, change title and keep the minimum version at 1.15, use description to say what the player receives, unit sections belong in their own files

sections.code:
[mod]
# 教程配套项目 / Tutorial project
title: Patrol Pair
description: Two ground vehicles for learning unit basics and inheritance
minVersion: 1.15

title.zh: 导入并找到两辆车

body.zh: 把原始 .rwmod 导入游戏的模组管理界面，启用并重新加载，在沙盒单位列表搜索 Patrol 或单位代号，先确认两辆车都能出现，再改代码，这样遇到错误时容易判断是哪一步引起的
body.en: Import the original .rwmod through the game mod manager, enable it and reload, search for Patrol or the unit ID in the sandbox, confirm that both vehicles appear before changing code

sections.code:
[core]
name: rwa01Scout
displayText: 巡逻侦察车 / Patrol Scout
showInEditor: true

title.zh: 只改一个地方再试
title.en: Change one thing at a time

body.zh: 先把侦察车显示名称改成自己的名字，保存、重新打包并重载，确认名称变化后再改生命和速度，保留下载时的原文件作为回退版本
body.en: First change the scout display name, save, repackage and reload, once the new name appears, move on to health and speed, retain the downloaded original as a rollback copy

outcome.zh: 能解释每种文件的用途，并在沙盒中找到两个自定义单位
outcome.en: Explain each file and find both custom units in the sandbox

exercise.zh: 给两辆车各取一个中文名称，保持 name 不变
exercise.en: Rename both display labels without changing their internal name keys

title.zh: 把一辆车拆成四个基础部分

summary.zh: 分清核心、图像、攻击与移动，学会安全修改数值
summary.en: Separate core, graphics, attack and movement before tuning values

title.zh: 先读核心参数

body.zh: name 是其他配置引用的代号，displayText 才是玩家看到的名字，price 是造价，maxHp 是生命上限，mass 和 radius 影响碰撞表现，第一次练习先保留这些碰撞参数
body.en: name is the internal identifier used by other configurations, displayText is the visible name, price is the cost and maxHp is maximum health, keep mass and radius unchanged while learning

sections.code:
[core]
name: rwa01Scout
displayText: 巡逻侦察车 / Patrol Scout
price: 250
maxHp: 200
mass: 2000
radius: 11

title.zh: 让不同段落各管一件事

body.zh: graphics 决定使用哪张图，attack 决定能打谁，movement 决定怎么走，把键放到对应段落中，同名键在不同段落下可能具有不同含义
body.en: graphics chooses the images, attack sets eligible targets and movement defines travel, place each key in the matching section because the same spelling can mean different things in different sections

sections.code:
[graphics]
image: body.png

[attack]
canAttack: true
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits: true
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false

[movement]
movementType: LAND
moveSpeed: 1.2

title.zh: 理解数值与单位

body.zh: 布尔开关使用 true 或 false，颜色采用十六进制，时间写 8s 便于直接看懂，buildSpeed 的裸数是进度速率，不能把 8 和 8s 当成同一回事
body.en: Boolean switches use true or false and colors use hexadecimal values, write times such as 8s for clarity, a bare buildSpeed number is a progress rate and does not mean the same thing as a time in seconds

sections.code:
[core]
buildSpeed: 8s

[attack]
shootDelay: 1s

[projectile_shell]
color: #FFE1B0

title.zh: 用护卫车做对照

body.zh: 护卫车的生命更高但移动更慢，这让两辆车有不同用途，练习时把侦察车生命从 200 改到 240，再用同样的敌人测试，记录改动前后能承受多少次命中
body.en: The guard has more health and moves more slowly, giving the pair distinct roles, raise scout health from 200 to 240 and test against the same enemy, record how many hits it survives before and after

outcome.zh: 知道一个参数属于哪个基础段落，能按目标修改而不误改其他系统
outcome.en: Place settings in the right section and change one behavior at a time

exercise.zh: 把侦察车改为 240 生命、300 造价，解释这两项改动对玩法的影响
exercise.en: Set the scout to 240 health and 300 credits, then explain the gameplay tradeoff

title.zh: 画一辆看得清的俯视战车

summary.zh: 从小尺寸透明贴图开始，分别绘制底盘和炮塔
summary.en: Start with small transparent images and separate the hull from the turret

title.zh: 先定画布和轮廓

body.zh: 示例底盘使用 24×24 像素透明画布，车头朝画面上方，先画深色履带，再画较亮车身，缩小到游戏中的尺寸仍能认出轮廓，比堆很多细节更重要
body.en: The sample hull uses a transparent 24×24 canvas with the front pointing up, draw dark tracks and a lighter body, prioritize a recognizable silhouette at game scale over tiny detail

title.zh: 让炮塔可以单独转动

body.zh: body.png 只画车身，turret.png 绘制炮塔和炮管，两个文件放在 INI 同一目录中，单位配置分别引用它们，炮管朝上便于观察旋转方向
body.en: Keep the hull in body.png and the turret with its barrel in turret.png, place both beside the INI file and reference them separately, use an upward-facing barrel to inspect rotation

sections.code:
[graphics]
image: body.png
image_turret: turret.png
image_wreak: NONE
image_shadow: NONE
total_frames: 1

title.zh: 对齐炮塔中心

body.zh: 炮塔坐标相对于单位中心，先用 x:0 与 y:0，若视觉上偏离车身中心，先检查 PNG 周围的透明留白是否对称，再改坐标，避免用很大的偏移掩盖图片本身不居中的问题
body.en: Turret coordinates are relative to the unit center, start at x:0 and y:0, if the art looks offset, inspect transparent padding before changing coordinates

sections.code:
[turret_main]
x: 0
y: 0
projectile: shell

title.zh: 导出后做三个观察
title.en: Check the result in three situations

body.zh: 导出透明 PNG 替换对应文件，检查静止时车身是否清楚、转向时炮塔是否围绕正确位置旋转、浅色和深色地形上是否都能分辨轮廓，保存一份未合并图层的编辑源文件
body.en: Export transparent PNGs and replace the corresponding files, check the stationary silhouette, turret rotation and contrast on light and dark terrain, retain an editable source file

outcome.zh: 完成车身与炮塔两张原创 PNG，并在单位配置中正确引用
outcome.en: Create two original PNGs and reference them correctly

exercise.zh: 给护卫车画更宽的履带，用相同尺寸保留单位中心位置
exercise.en: Give the guard wider tracks while keeping the same canvas size and center

title.zh: 让移动手感符合单位定位
title.en: Tune movement for the unit role

summary.zh: 一起调整速度、加减速和转向，避免所有单位像同一辆车
summary.en: Tune speed, acceleration and turning so vehicles feel distinct

title.zh: 先选移动类型

body.zh: 巡逻双车组使用 LAND，适合地面车辆，移动类型会影响寻路能力，不会自动让一张坦克图变成飞机，新手先在同一种类型中比较速度
body.en: Patrol Pair uses LAND for ground vehicles, movement type affects pathfinding and does not automatically turn tank art into an aircraft, compare speeds within one movement type first

sections.code:
[movement]
movementType: LAND
moveSpeed: 1.2

title.zh: 把起步与停车一起考虑

body.zh: moveAccelerationSpeed 控制加速，moveDecelerationSpeed 控制减速，速度很高但减速很低可能难以停在预期位置，先使用示例中的同一组数值，只改一项观察差别
body.en: moveAccelerationSpeed controls acceleration and moveDecelerationSpeed controls deceleration, very high speed with slow braking can make stopping awkward, keep the sample values and change one at a time

sections.code:
moveAccelerationSpeed: 0.06
moveDecelerationSpeed: 0.06
maxTurnSpeed: 3
turnAcceleration: 0.3

title.zh: 建立一条固定测试路线

body.zh: 在沙盒选一段有直线、转弯和狭窄路口的路线，同时派侦察车和护卫车前往，记录谁先到达以及哪里发生拥堵，同一条路线重复测试才容易比较参数
body.en: Create a route with a straight section, a turn and a narrow passage, send the scout and guard together and record arrival order and congestion, repeat on the same route for useful comparisons

title.zh: 为角色留下差异

body.zh: 侦察车适合快速探路，护卫车适合跟随和正面交战，若只给护卫车加生命又把速度提到相同水平，侦察车可能失去用途，调整后同时检查造价与战场定位
body.en: The scout favors exploration while the guard favors frontline combat, matching their speed while keeping the guard tougher can erase the scout role, review cost and purpose after tuning

outcome.zh: 能用固定路线比较移动手感，而不是凭一次移动猜测结果
outcome.en: Compare movement on a repeatable route

exercise.zh: 做一辆速度 0.9 的中型版本，并写下它与另外两车的区别
exercise.en: Create a medium variant with speed 0.9 and describe its role

title.zh: 从炮塔一直追到命中的弹体
title.en: Follow a shot from turret to projectile

summary.zh: 理解攻击开关、射程、射击间隔和炮弹引用
summary.en: Understand target permissions, range, fire interval and projectile references

title.zh: 单位先决定能打谁

body.zh: 即使写好了炮塔，attack 中的开关也要允许目标类型，当前示例只打地面，不攻击空中或水下目标，测试时先使用地面敌军
body.en: A turret still needs the attack section to permit its target category, this sample attacks ground targets only, start testing against enemy ground units

sections.code:
[attack]
canAttack: true
canAttackFlyingUnits: false
canAttackLandUnits: true
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false
maxAttackRange: 150
shootDelay: 1s

title.zh: 炮塔引用已经定义的弹体

body.zh: projectile:shell 指向 projectile_shell 这一段，引用时只写后缀，改名时同时修改定义和引用，炮塔的位置与转向决定炮口表现
body.en: projectile:shell refers to the projectile_shell section, use only the suffix in the reference and update both ends when renaming it

sections.code:
[turret_main]
x: 0
y: 0
projectile: shell

[projectile_shell]
directDamage: 18
life: 1.5s
speed: 4
drawSize: 1
color: #FFE1B0

title.zh: 先分开调伤害和频率

body.zh: 单发伤害决定一次命中的影响，shootDelay 决定两次射击的间隔，先把伤害改成 24，保持间隔不变，再单独比较 1s 和 1.5s，实际输出还受命中与装甲影响
body.en: Damage changes each hit while shootDelay changes the interval between shots, try 24 damage with the same interval, then compare 1s and 1.5s separately, actual output also depends on hits and armor

title.zh: 给弹体留足存在时间

body.zh: life 太短时弹体可能在到达目标前消失，先沿用示例的寿命与速度，在最大射程附近测试，再考虑加大射程，单独提高 maxAttackRange 可能让远处目标进入射程却打不中
body.en: A short life can remove a projectile before it arrives, keep the sample lifetime and speed while testing near maximum range, increasing range alone can create targets the projectile cannot reach

outcome.zh: 能说明一发子弹依赖哪些段落，并找出常见的不攻击原因
outcome.en: Trace the sections involved in a shot and diagnose basic firing problems

exercise.zh: 让护卫车射击更慢但单发更重，记录相同目标的消灭时间
exercise.en: Make the guard fire slower with heavier hits and record time to defeat a fixed target

title.zh: 完成你的第一支双车小队

summary.zh: 用继承建立第二辆车，把图片、代码和测试记录一起交付
summary.en: Use inheritance for a variant and package art, code and test notes together

title.zh: 用同目录文件作为基础

body.zh: guard.ini 通过 copyFrom 读取 scout.ini，未覆盖的配置继续沿用，第二辆车必须使用新的 name，否则两个单位会争用同一个代号，路径相对于当前 INI 文件
body.en: guard.ini reads scout.ini through copyFrom, unchanged settings stay inherited, the second vehicle needs its own name, paths are relative to the current INI file

sections.code:
# 继承同目录下的侦察车 / Inherit the scout in this folder
[core]
copyFrom: scout.ini
name: rwa01Guard
displayText: 巡逻护卫车 / Patrol Guard
price: 450
maxHp: 420
mass: 3500

[graphics]
image: guard.png

[projectile_shell]
directDamage: 28

[movement]
moveSpeed: 0.75

title.zh: 覆盖需要改变的部分

body.zh: 护卫车只改生命、价格、图片、伤害与速度，不必再复制一遍整套炮塔配置，将来修正共同的弹体行为时优先修改基础文件，再确认变体仍符合预期
body.en: The guard changes health, cost, image, damage and speed, avoid duplicating the whole weapon setup, fix shared behavior in the base file and verify that variants still behave as intended

title.zh: 把教学项目改成自己的作品

body.zh: 给模组和两辆车起新名字，更换两张车身图，保留可分辨的快车与重车定位，在 README 中写出如何找到单位、是否需要工厂入口，以及你测试的游戏版本
body.en: Rename the project and its two vehicles, replace both hull images and preserve the light and heavy roles, document how to find them, whether a factory entry exists and the version you tested

title.zh: 检查压缩包内的完整性

body.zh: 确认 mod-info.txt、两个 INI 和所有 PNG 都在包里，解压到一个新目录再检查一次引用，分享前启用两个示例项目同时加载，确认内部名称没有冲突
body.en: Check that mod-info.txt, both INI files and every PNG are included, extract into a fresh folder to verify references, load alongside another project to check for internal name collisions

outcome.zh: 得到一个有两种定位、独立素材和使用说明的完整模组包
outcome.en: Deliver a complete two-role mod with original assets and instructions

exercise.zh: 额外新增一辆中型车，用继承完成并与前两辆一起测试
exercise.en: Add a medium vehicle through inheritance and test all three together

title.zh: 给单位一个会记事的按钮
title.en: Give a unit a button with memory

summary.zh: 声明变量、出生初始化，并让按钮切换单位状态
summary.en: Declare variables, initialize them on creation and toggle a state with a button

title.zh: 先说清需要记住什么

body.zh: 变弹战车需要记录累计射击次数和是否开启加强弹，分别使用 number 与 boolean，内存属于当前单位，两辆车各自维护自己的值
body.en: The switchfire tank remembers a shot count and whether enhanced ammunition is enabled, use number and boolean, memory belongs to each unit rather than the whole team

sections.code:
[core]
defineUnitMemory: number shots, boolean powered

title.zh: 出生时给出初始值

body.zh: created 事件适合完成一次初始化，shots 从 0 开始，powered 从 false 开始，后续动作读取到的状态就有明确含义
body.en: Use the created event for one-time initialization, start shots at 0 and powered at false so later actions read a clear state

sections.code:
[hiddenAction_initialize]
autoTriggerOnEvent: created
setUnitMemory: shots=0, powered=false

title.zh: 按钮只做一次简单变更

body.zh: 玩家按钮用 setUnitMemory 把 powered 反转，buildSpeed:0 适合这个无需排队等待的切换示例，复杂技能以后再逐步添加费用、时间或限制
body.en: The button flips powered with setUnitMemory, buildSpeed:0 suits this immediate toggle, add costs, duration and restrictions later when the basic behavior works

sections.code:
[action_toggle]
text: 切换弹种 / Switch ammo
description: 射击次数 / Shots: %{memory.shots}
buildSpeed: 0
setUnitMemory: powered=not memory.powered

title.zh: 区分赋值与显示

body.zh: setUnitMemory 使用变量名加等号，读取当前值时写 memory.powered，按钮说明中的 %{memory.shots} 在显示时求值，普通字符串里的变量名不会自动变化
body.en: Use the variable name on the left of an assignment and memory.powered when reading it, %{memory.shots} evaluates inside supported dynamic text, plain text does not evaluate variable names

outcome.zh: 拥有一个能切换布尔状态并显示单位计数的按钮
outcome.en: Create a button that toggles a boolean state and displays a per-unit counter

exercise.zh: 新增 boolean marked，给它一个单独按钮和状态说明
exercise.en: Add a boolean marked variable with its own button and status text

title.zh: 让炮塔根据状态选择弹药

summary.zh: 把按钮、条件弹体和射击事件连成一个可观察的流程
summary.en: Connect the button, conditional projectile and firing event

title.zh: 定义两个不同的弹体

body.zh: 普通弹保留 18 点直接伤害，加强弹为 30 点并使用蓝色，让玩家通过颜色判断模式，先用视觉和伤害都明显的差异确认切换确实生效
body.en: Keep normal damage at 18 and set enhanced damage to 30 with a blue color, obvious visual and numerical differences make mode testing easier

sections.code:
[projectile_powered]
directDamage: 30
life: 1.5s
speed: 4
drawSize: 1.3
color: #80D8FF

title.zh: 把选择交给炮塔条件

body.zh: projectile 是默认弹体，altProjectile 是条件弹体，只有 altProjectileCondition 成立时才改用加强弹，条件读取上一章按钮修改的内存
body.en: projectile is the default and altProjectile is the conditional alternative, the alternative is selected when altProjectileCondition is true, reading the memory changed by the button

sections.code:
[turret_main]
x: 0
y: 0
projectile: shell
altProjectile: powered
altProjectileCondition: memory.powered
onShoot_triggerActions: countShot

title.zh: 在真正开火时计数

body.zh: 将计数动作挂在炮塔的开火事件上，避免只要点击切换按钮就加一次，赋值写成旧值加一，创建动作时要保证调用名称与动作后缀一致
body.en: Attach the counter to the turret firing event so a button click does not count as a shot, assign the old value plus one and keep the action reference consistent

sections.code:
[hiddenAction_countShot]
setUnitMemory: shots=memory.shots + 1

title.zh: 设计一组能复现的测试

body.zh: 创建一辆战车，普通模式射击三次，切换后再射击两次，期望计数为 5，最后另建一辆车确认计数为 0，测试过程中避免多辆车混在一起导致观察不清
body.en: Spawn one tank, fire three normal shots and two enhanced shots, expect a count of 5, then create another tank and expect its count to start at 0

outcome.zh: 按钮状态真正影响下一次射击，计数与实际开火对应
outcome.en: Make the button affect subsequent shots and keep the counter aligned with firing

exercise.zh: 为第三种弹药先画状态转换草图，再决定是否仍适合布尔变量
exercise.en: Sketch a three-ammunition state flow and decide whether a boolean still fits

title.zh: 用能量限制持续火力
title.en: Use energy to limit sustained fire

summary.zh: 把短时间爆发与长时间输出拆开考虑
summary.en: Separate short bursts from sustained damage

title.zh: 设置容量与恢复

body.zh: 蓄能战车最多储存 12 能量，出生时充满，energyRegen 使用游戏自己的恢复速率，不要直接把数值当成每秒回复量，先在游戏中测量从空到满所需时间
body.en: The tank stores 12 energy and starts full, energyRegen uses the engine regeneration rate rather than an assumed per-second unit, measure recharge time in the game

sections.code:
[core]
energyMax: 12
energyStartingPercentage: 1
energyRegen: 0.03

title.zh: 每次开火支付能量

body.zh: 炮塔 energyUsage:2 表示每发消耗 2 能量，在没有恢复的理想情况下，满能量能支付 6 发，实际连续射击时恢复同时发生，因此以游戏观察为准
body.en: energyUsage:2 costs two energy per shot, a full charge could fund six shots if regeneration were absent, regeneration can occur during combat so verify sustained behavior in game

sections.code:
[turret_main]
x: 0
y: 0
projectile: shell
energyUsage: 2

title.zh: 比较三个阶段

body.zh: 分别记录满能量开始的前几发、能量接近耗尽后的持续输出、完全停火后的恢复，若只看第一轮爆发，会低估长时间交战中的弱点
body.en: Record the opening burst, sustained output near depletion and recovery after firing stops, evaluating only the first burst hides long-fight weaknesses

title.zh: 把维修与补能分开

body.zh: 维修工程车修复生命，战车依靠 energyRegen 恢复能量，这个项目中维修不会直接补充能量，设计技能时为玩家写清恢复的是哪一种数值
body.en: The engineer restores health while the tank regenerates energy through energyRegen, repairs do not refill energy in this project, describe the restored resource clearly to players

sections.code:
[core]
isBuilder: true
canRepairUnits: true
canRepairBuildings: true
nanoRange: 100
nanoRepairSpeed: 0.3

outcome.zh: 能解释为什么战车开局火力与持续火力不同
outcome.en: Explain why opening and sustained firepower differ

exercise.zh: 做两组容量和恢复方案，记录它们在 30 秒战斗中的表现
exercise.en: Compare two capacity and regeneration settings over a 30-second fight

title.zh: 用继承维护一整组单位
title.en: Maintain a family of units with inheritance

summary.zh: 减少重复代码，同时保留清楚的单位差异
summary.en: Reduce duplication while keeping variant differences readable

title.zh: 选择真正共用的基础

body.zh: 变弹实验场的两辆车共用按钮、内存和弹药逻辑，基础文件 mode.ini 本身也是一个可用单位，变体 guard.ini 只覆盖重量级车辆的差异
body.en: Both switchfire vehicles share controls, memory and ammunition, mode.ini is a playable base unit while guard.ini overrides the heavier variant

sections.code:
# 使用相同操作逻辑，只改基础数值 / Reuse the controls with different stats
[core]
copyFrom: mode.ini
name: rwa02ModeGuard
displayText: 变弹护卫车 / Switchfire Guard
price: 650
maxHp: 460

[graphics]
image: guard.png

[movement]
moveSpeed: 0.7

title.zh: 沿着继承顺序查结果

body.zh: 如果护卫车射击次数不增加，先看基础文件的炮塔事件和计数动作，若只有护卫车速度异常，再看变体 movement 的覆盖值，按共同问题与个别问题区分排查范围
body.en: If shot counting fails for both vehicles, inspect the base turret event and counter action, if only the guard speed is wrong, inspect its movement override

title.zh: 复用段落也有办法

body.zh: 文件继承适合单位变体，段落模板适合同一文件中多个相似炮塔，共用 delay 等参数时可以用 template 段落，仍然为每个炮塔补上位置和弹体引用
body.en: File inheritance suits unit variants, section templates suit repeated turrets within a file, share values such as delay and still provide each turret position and projectile

sections.code:
[template_weapon]
delay: 1.2s

[turret_left]
@copyFromSection: template_weapon
x: -7
y: 0
projectile: shell

[turret_right]
@copyFromSection: template_weapon
x: 7
y: 0
projectile: shell

title.zh: 避免层层套娃

body.zh: 新手项目优先保持一层基础加一层变体，公共文件改动后检查所有依赖它的单位，重命名文件或移动目录时同时更新 copyFrom 路径
body.en: Prefer one base and one variant layer for small projects, test every dependent unit after changing shared code and update copyFrom when moving or renaming files

outcome.zh: 能通过继承建立变体，也能判断应该在哪个文件修正问题
outcome.en: Create variants and identify where shared or individual bugs belong

exercise.zh: 增加第三辆变弹车，只覆盖价格、生命、速度和贴图
exercise.en: Add a third switchfire vehicle overriding only cost, health, speed and art

title.zh: 让建筑生产单位并共享研究资源
title.en: Build units and share research resources

summary.zh: 连接建造菜单、全队资源和一次性升级
summary.en: Connect construction menus, team resources and one-time upgrades

title.zh: 先把建筑放进沙盒
title.en: Place the building in the sandbox

body.zh: 研究站使用 isBuilding 和占地矩形，movementType:NONE 保持固定，这个项目先从沙盒放置研究站，建造入口可以在确认建筑本身正常后再加入其他工程单位
body.en: The outpost uses isBuilding and footprint rectangles with movementType:NONE, place it from the sandbox first and add builder access after its own behavior works

sections.code:
[core]
isBuilding: true
footprint: -1,-1,1,1
constructionFootprint: -1,-1,1,1

[movement]
movementType: NONE
moveSpeed: 0

title.zh: 用内部名称连接生产菜单
title.en: Use internal names in production menus

body.zh: canBuild 的 name 指向战车 core.name，不是它的中文显示名，pos 控制菜单位置，生产需要的时间和价格可以先沿用目标单位的配置
body.en: A canBuild name refers to the unit core.name rather than its display label, pos controls menu placement, start with the target unit cost and build time

sections.code:
[canBuild_rover]
name: rwa04Rover
pos: 1

title.zh: 把团队资源和单位状态分开
title.en: Separate team resources from unit state

body.zh: l04data 是全队共享的研究数据，upgraded 是某一辆车自己的升级状态，研究站花 100 资金获得一份数据，车辆用数据购买升级，不要把资源写成 memory.l04data
body.en: l04data is shared research data while upgraded belongs to one rover, the outpost converts 100 credits into one data and a rover spends it on an upgrade, do not address the resource as memory.l04data

sections.code:
[global_resource_l04data]
displayName: 研究数据 / Research Data
displayInHud: true

[action_research]
text: 记录数据 / Record data
price: credits=100
buildSpeed: 2s
addResources: l04data=1

title.zh: 阻止同一辆车反复付费
title.en: Prevent repeated purchases on one rover

body.zh: 界面锁定给玩家说明，执行条件再次检查当前状态，升级完成后让炮塔读取 upgraded 来选择弹体，创建两辆战车验证升级只影响购买它的那一辆
body.en: Use a lock message for the interface and an execution condition to check the state again, the turret reads upgraded afterward, verify that purchasing on one rover does not upgrade another

sections.code:
[action_upgrade]
text: 装填改良弹 / Improve ammunition
price: l04data=1
buildSpeed: 1s
isLocked: if memory.upgraded
isLockedMessage: 已完成改良 / Already upgraded
requireConditional: if not memory.upgraded
setUnitMemory: upgraded=true

outcome.zh: 得到一个生产车辆、积累数据并为单车购买升级的完整流程
outcome.en: Build a complete production, research and per-unit upgrade loop

exercise.zh: 把升级费用改为两份数据，验证余额不足与已经升级两种提示
exercise.en: Raise the upgrade cost to two data and check insufficient-resource and already-upgraded states

title.zh: 用小动画表达单位状态
title.en: Communicate state with a small animation

summary.zh: 从一个轻微脉动开始，学会关键帧与视觉节制
summary.en: Start with a subtle pulse and learn keyframes without obscuring gameplay

title.zh: 先选择要传达的信息
title.en: Choose the message of the animation

body.zh: 维修车的轻微空闲脉动用于让支援单位容易识别，不承担实际维修逻辑，视觉表现与技能效果分别检查，避免动画动了就误以为数值也生效
body.en: The medic subtle idle pulse makes a support unit easier to spot, it does not implement repair logic, test visuals and gameplay effects separately

title.zh: 两个关键帧就能开始

body.zh: body_0s 是起点，body_1s 是一秒后的目标值，scale 从 1 到 1.05，pingPong 让动画往返播放，较小的缩放有助于保持单位轮廓稳定
body.en: body_0s is the starting value and body_1s is the value one second later, scale changes from 1 to 1.05 and pingPong reverses the motion, subtle scaling keeps the silhouette stable

title.zh: 为动画保留图片空间

body.zh: 如果以后改为帧动画，先把每一帧画在相同尺寸的格子里，保持单位中心一致，当前示例只有单帧 PNG，不需要为了脉动额外拼接帧表
body.en: For a future sprite-sheet animation, use equal-sized cells and keep the center aligned, this sample uses one PNG frame and does not require a sheet for its scale pulse

title.zh: 在真实大小下检查干扰

body.zh: 观察一辆和十辆维修车同时出现的场面，过大的缩放和过快的频率容易抢走注意力，调整动画时同时查看选中圈、队伍识别与周围单位的可读性
body.en: Observe one medic and a group of ten, large scaling and rapid pulses can distract from combat, check selection markers, team recognition and nearby silhouettes

outcome.zh: 掌握简单关键帧动画，并能判断它是否帮助玩家理解单位
outcome.en: Create a simple keyframe animation and assess its readability

exercise.zh: 比较 1.03 与 1.10 的缩放，选出小队场景下更清楚的一组
exercise.en: Compare 1.03 and 1.10 scaling and choose the clearer option in a squad scene

title.zh: 分清车载库存、队伍储备与单位记忆
title.en: Separate inventory, team stock and unit memory

summary.zh: 用两辆指挥车观察数据属于谁，避免一处修改影响整个队伍
summary.en: Use two carriers to see which data is local and which data belongs to the team

title.zh: 先问这份数据属于谁

body.zh: 车载补给跟随一辆车，车队储备属于整个队伍，收到多少次信号则只是这辆车的记录，先按用途分开，再选择 resource、global_resource 或 memory，变量名相同不代表数据就会共享
body.en: Onboard supplies belong to one carrier, fleet stock belongs to the team, and the signal count is a record kept by one vehicle, choose local resources, global resources or memory according to ownership

sections.code:
[resource_v07cells]
displayName: 车载补给 / Onboard supplies
displayInHud: false

[global_resource_v07stock]
displayName: 车队储备 / Fleet stock
displayInHud: true

title.zh: 资源适合收取，记忆适合记录状态
title.en: Use resources for costs and memory for state

body.zh: price 可以直接要求一份资源，数量不足时就不能支付，memory 用来保存计数和开关，不会自动成为造价或库存，不要用一个布尔值代替可消耗数量
body.en: A price can directly require a resource and cannot be paid without enough stock, memory stores counters and switches and does not automatically act as a spendable balance

sections.code:
[core]
defineUnitMemory: number signals

[hiddenAction_initialize]
autoTriggerOnEvent: created
setUnitMemory: signals=0
addResources: v07cells=3

[action_useSupply]
text: 使用一份补给 / Use one supply
price: v07cells=1
buildSpeed: 1s
showMessageToPlayer: Supply used

title.zh: 用两个步骤体现资源流向

body.zh: 先把 100 资金转换成一份队伍储备，再由任意指挥车领取三份本车补给，两辆车都能支付队伍储备，只有领取的车增加本地库存，两个按钮比一个同时操作多种资源的按钮更容易观察
body.en: First convert 100 credits into one team stock, then let any carrier exchange that stock for three onboard supplies, the shared stock is available to both carriers while only the receiving carrier gains local inventory

sections.code:
[action_buyStock]
text: 采购储备 / Buy stock
price: credits=100
buildSpeed: 2s
addResources: v07stock=1

[action_reload]
text: 领取补给 / Load supplies
price: v07stock=1
buildSpeed: 2s
addResources: v07cells=3

title.zh: 用成对单位排查作用域
title.en: Compare two units to inspect scope

body.zh: 让 A 采购、B 领取，再分别查看状态，A 和 B 看到的车队储备应一致，车载补给和信号数则可以不同，记录每一步前后的值，能迅速区分资源扣错对象和显示文字写错
body.en: Buy stock with A and collect supplies with B, both should report the same fleet stock while their inventory and signal counts may differ, compare values before and after each step

sections.code:
[action_report]
text: 查看状态 / Status
buildSpeed: 0
showMessageToPlayer: Signals=%{memory.signals}, supplies=%{self.resource.v07cells}, fleet stock=%{self.resource.v07stock}

outcome.zh: 能按用途选择本地资源、队伍资源和单位记忆
outcome.en: Choose local resources, team resources and memory by their purpose

exercise.zh: 画一张资金到储备再到车载补给的流向图，标出每一步由谁持有
exercise.en: Draw the flow from credits to team stock to inventory, marking the owner at each stage

title.zh: 让挂载电台给指挥车发送消息
title.en: Send a radio message to the parent carrier

summary.zh: 分开发送、筛选和接收，把协作逻辑拆成清晰的小职责
summary.en: Separate sending, filtering and receiving into small responsibilities

title.zh: 先建立明确的父子关系

body.zh: 电台是独立单位，通过 attachment_radio 出现在指挥车上，电台可以用 parent 找到所属车体，父级引用依赖实际挂载关系，单独创建一辆普通车辆并不会自动得到这段关系
body.en: The radio is a separate unit placed on the carrier through attachment_radio, it can address its carrier using parent, that reference depends on the real attachment relationship

sections.code:
[attachment_radio]
x: 0
y: -3
onCreateSpawnUnitOf: rwa07Radio
showAllActionsFrom: true
isUnselectable: true
canBeAttackedAndDamaged: false

title.zh: 消息只携带这次需要的数据
title.en: Send only the data needed for this event

body.zh: 电台按钮不直接改车体的记忆，只发一个带 v07signal 标签的消息和数值 pulse，标签说明消息用途，数据说明本次发生了什么，把两者分开能减少以后扩展时的歧义
body.en: The radio button does not directly edit carrier memory, it sends a v07signal message containing pulse, the tag describes the purpose and the data describes this event

sections.code:
[action_sendSignal]
text: 发出联络信号 / Send a signal
buildSpeed: 0
sendMessageTo: parent
sendMessageWithTags: v07signal
sendMessageWithData: pulse=1

title.zh: 接收方决定如何回应
title.en: Let the receiver decide the response

body.zh: 接收动作只订阅自己的标签，再把事件里的 pulse 加到计数，eventData 只在这次事件中读取，想长期保存的信息要写进 memory，回退值 0 让缺少数据的消息不增加计数
body.en: The receiving action listens for its own tag and adds the event pulse to its counter, eventData belongs to this event while memory keeps a persistent record, a default of zero avoids incrementing on a missing value

sections.code:
[hiddenAction_receiveSignal]
autoTriggerOnEvent: newMessage(withTag='v07signal')
setUnitMemory: signals=memory.signals + eventData(name='pulse',type='number',default=0)
showMessageToPlayer: Signal count: %{memory.signals}

title.zh: 避免消息互相回发

body.zh: 先保持单向链路，电台发出一次，车体记录一次，若以后要增加确认消息，使用另一个标签，并让确认动作停止在接收方，不要让两个 newMessage 动作无条件互相发送同一个标签
body.en: Start with a one-way chain, one radio send should produce one carrier update, if acknowledgments are added later, use a different tag and stop the chain at its receiver instead of forwarding the same message back and forth

outcome.zh: 能实现一次发送对应一次更新的挂载协作
outcome.en: Implement one receiver update for each message sent

exercise.zh: 把 pulse 改为 2，再发三次消息，先预测计数变化再观察
exercise.en: Change pulse to 2 and send three messages, predict the count before observing it

title.zh: 让武器模式与目标分工保持一致
title.en: Keep weapon modes and target roles consistent

summary.zh: 组合替代弹体、模式记忆和地空筛选，避免两层规则互相抵消
summary.en: Combine alternate projectiles, mode memory and ground or air filters

title.zh: 单位许可与炮塔许可都要看
title.en: Inspect both unit and turret permissions

body.zh: attack 决定整辆车可以考虑哪些目标，turret_main 还可以继续限制这门炮，防空变体需要同时允许整车和炮塔攻击空中单位，只改一层可能仍然无法开火
body.en: attack defines targets the vehicle can consider and turret_main can further restrict the weapon, the anti-air variant changes both layers so they agree

sections.code:
[attack]
canAttack: true
canAttackFlyingUnits: true
canAttackLandUnits: false
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false

[turret_main]
canAttackFlyingUnits: true
canAttackLandUnits: false
canAttackUnderwaterUnits: false

title.zh: 同一门炮按状态选择弹体
title.en: Choose a projectile from remembered state

body.zh: 普通弹和稳定弹共用炮口，altProjectileCondition 读取当前模式，条件成立时使用 focused，否则使用 normal，这种写法适合只替换弹体而无需再复制整门炮的场景
body.en: Normal and focused shots use the same gun, altProjectileCondition reads the mode and selects focused when true, otherwise normal, this fits changes that need a new projectile without duplicating the gun

sections.code:
[turret_main]
x: 0
y: 0
projectile: normal
altProjectile: focused
altProjectileCondition: memory.focused

[projectile_normal]
directDamage: 20
life: 1.8s
speed: 4

[projectile_focused]
directDamage: 34
life: 1.8s
speed: 5

title.zh: 模式获得好处，也承担代价
title.en: Pair the benefit with a cost

body.zh: 稳定射击提高伤害，同时降低移动速度，恢复巡航时要把状态和速度一起还原，isLocked 控制按钮提示，requireConditional 则在执行时再次检查，减少排队期间状态变化造成的意外
body.en: Stabilization raises damage while reducing movement speed, cruise restores both state and speed, isLocked informs the player and requireConditional checks the state again when the action executes

sections.code:
[action_focus]
text: 稳定射击 / Stabilize
buildSpeed: 0
isLocked: if memory.focused
requireConditional: if not memory.focused
setUnitMemory: focused=true
setUnitStats: movespeed=0.35

[action_cruise]
text: 恢复巡航 / Resume cruise
buildSpeed: 0
isLocked: if not memory.focused
requireConditional: if memory.focused
setUnitMemory: focused=false
setUnitStats: movespeed=0.85

title.zh: 先对照弹体，再比较总表现
title.en: Compare projectiles before judging the whole unit

body.zh: 先在相同距离对同一目标观察普通弹和稳定弹，再检查移动速度，最后换成防空变体面对空中目标，测试时保持其他条件一致，避免把射程、装甲或目标类型差异误认为模式带来的提升
body.en: Compare both modes at the same distance against the same target, then inspect movement speed and finally use the anti-air variant against an air target, keep other conditions stable when comparing

outcome.zh: 能解释整车筛选、炮塔筛选和替代弹体各自负责什么
outcome.en: Explain vehicle filters, turret filters and alternate projectile selection

exercise.zh: 把稳定弹伤害改为 30，再写下你会如何调整移速代价
exercise.en: Reduce focused damage to 30 and describe how you would adjust its movement tradeoff

title.zh: 分清挂在车上的设备与装在舱里的乘员

summary.zh: 一个运输车同时携带电台与护卫，明确位置、容量和卸载职责
summary.en: Carry a radio and escorts while keeping position, capacity and unloading responsibilities clear

title.zh: 先按用途选择关系

body.zh: 电台需要固定出现在车顶，随车移动并显示专用按钮，适合挂载，护卫需要进入运输舱并在目的地下车，适合运输，同一辆车可以同时拥有两种关系，但不要把同一个单位重复当作两类乘员管理
body.en: The radio should remain at a fixed roof position and expose its own action, so it uses an attachment, escorts should enter a hold and later disembark, so they use transport, keep their responsibilities separate

title.zh: 用标签限制可装载对象

body.zh: 护卫带 v07cargo 标签并占一个槽，指挥车只接收此标签的陆地单位，容量是两个，标签筛选解决谁能上车，transportSlotsNeeded 解决上车占多少位置
body.en: Each escort has v07cargo and uses one slot, the carrier accepts tagged land units with a capacity of two, tags determine eligibility and slot cost determines capacity usage

sections.code:
[core]
maxTransportingUnits: 2
transportUnitsRequireTag: v07cargo
transportUnitsRequireMovementType: LAND
transportUnitsEachUnitAlwaysUsesSingleSlot: true
transportUnitsAddUnloadOption: true
transportUnitsUnloadDelayBetweenEachUnit: 1s

# 护卫的 core 段 / In the escort core section
# tags: v07cargo
# transportSlotsNeeded: 1

title.zh: 挂载位置与乘员容量分别观察

body.zh: radio 槽的 x、y 控制电台相对车体的位置，运输舱容量由 core 管理，先让车转向观察电台是否跟随，再装入两辆护卫查看乘员计数，避免用运输容量解释电台的显示位置
body.en: The radio slot x and y place the pod relative to the hull while core manages hold capacity, first turn the carrier to inspect the pod and then load escorts to inspect passenger count

sections.code:
[attachment_radio]
x: 0
y: -3
height: 1
lockRotation: true
setDrawLayerOnTop: true
onCreateSpawnUnitOf: rwa07Radio
showAllActionsFrom: true

[action_report]
text: 查看乘员 / Passenger count
buildSpeed: 0
showMessageToPlayer: Passengers=%{self.transportingCount}

title.zh: 卸载要考虑目的地空间

body.zh: 先在空旷陆地进行装载和卸载，再检查靠近障碍物的情况，运输关系还涉及死亡、换队和变形时如何处理乘员，设计特殊行为前先写出预期，再查对应选项，避免照搬另一种运输单位的规则
body.en: Begin loading and unloading on open land before trying obstacles, death, team changes and conversion also affect passengers, write down the intended behavior before choosing those options

outcome.zh: 能在同一车体上管理固定设备与可卸载乘员
outcome.en: Manage fixed equipment and unloadable passengers on one carrier

exercise.zh: 新增一类没有 v07cargo 标签的车，观察它与护卫的装载差别
exercise.en: Add a vehicle without v07cargo and compare its loading behavior with the escort

title.zh: 让效果说明状态，让继承维护一致性
title.en: Use effects to communicate state and inheritance to keep it consistent

summary.zh: 把枪口光、车体动画和共用配置组织成容易修改的一套规则
summary.en: Organize muzzle flashes, hull animation and shared settings into a maintainable set

title.zh: 先确认效果服务什么信息
title.en: Give each effect an informational role

body.zh: 稳定按钮出现一次扩散光，表示模式切换，开火时枪口光表示射击瞬间，轻微待机缩放只是增加生命感，效果应当帮助玩家理解状态，不能靠很强的闪烁掩盖模式没有真正改变
body.en: A short expanding glow signals stabilization, the muzzle flash marks a shot, and a subtle idle scale adds life, effects should communicate behavior rather than hide a missing state change

sections.code:
[action_focus]
spawnEffects: CUSTOM:signal

[turret_main]
shoot_flame: CUSTOM:signal

[effect_signal]
image: glow.png
life: 24
alpha: 0.8
scaleFrom: 0.6
scaleTo: 1.5
fadeOut: true
attachedToUnit: false
color: #8AE9D1

title.zh: 从小幅度关键帧开始
title.en: Start with a subtle keyframe change

body.zh: 待机动画只让车体在 1 与 1.03 倍之间往返，不改变真实碰撞和生命值，先观察缩放能否看清，再决定是否保留，关键帧中的 scale 属于动画表现，不是单位攻击或碰撞半径
body.en: The idle animation moves between scale 1 and 1.03 without changing collision or health, inspect readability before keeping it, animation scale is a visual property

title.zh: 变体只覆盖自己负责的差异

body.zh: 防空车继承 firecontrol.ini，保留模式按钮、记忆初始化和效果，只覆盖名字、价格、贴图和目标类型，修改基础效果后两个单位都能受益，若想单独改变某个变体，再在它的对应段落覆盖
body.en: Skyguard inherits the mode actions, memory setup and effects from firecontrol.ini and overrides identity, cost, art and target role, a base effect change then applies to both

sections.code:
[core]
copyFrom: firecontrol.ini
name: rwa08Skyguard
displayText: 防空火控车 / Skyguard
price: 650
maxHp: 320

[graphics]
image: skyguard.png

[attack]
canAttackFlyingUnits: true
canAttackLandUnits: false
maxAttackRange: 210

title.zh: 维护一张引用清单

body.zh: 改名时依次跟踪 INI 继承文件、图片路径、炮塔的弹体名、CUSTOM 特效名、动作名和动画名，程序能找到文件不代表每一条名称引用都正确，保留公共基础文件，避免让 A 继承 B、B 又继承 A
body.en: When renaming, follow inheritance paths, image files, projectile names, CUSTOM effects, actions and animation names, an existing file does not guarantee that every named reference is valid, avoid inheritance cycles

outcome.zh: 能修改共用效果并知道哪些变体会一起变化
outcome.en: Edit shared effects and identify affected variants

exercise.zh: 把共用光效改成另一种颜色，预测两个变体的变化，再仅覆盖防空车的颜色
exercise.en: Change the shared glow color and predict both variants, then override the color only in Skyguard

title.zh: 把时间、区域与增援串成一个事件
title.en: Combine time, a region and reinforcements

summary.zh: 让两项条件同时满足后只触发一次，学会追踪地图对象间的连接
summary.en: Require two conditions and a single activation while tracing links between map objects

title.zh: 把目标写成可判断的条件
title.en: Write the objective as measurable conditions

body.zh: 目标设为开局经过 20 秒，并且两辆防守车在指定区域停留 3 秒，再发一批增援，时间条件、单位检测和结果各用一个对象，这样可以单独检查每一步，不必把全部规则塞进同一个对象
body.en: The objective requires 20 seconds since map start and two defenders staying in a region for 3 seconds, followed by one reinforcement group, separate the clock, detector and result so each step is inspectable

title.zh: 检测对象只描述区域和单位
title.en: Keep the detector focused on units and area

body.zh: unitDetect 的矩形是检查范围，team 指定队伍，onlyWithTag 对应单位 core 的 v08defender 标签，minUnits 为 2，warmup 表示条件要持续满足，先确认地图真的存在队伍 0，再放入两辆带标签的单位
body.en: The unitDetect rectangle defines the region, team selects the side and onlyWithTag matches v08defender in core, minUnits is two and warmup requires the condition to remain true, ensure the map contains team 0

sections.code:
<object name="v08_zone" type="unitDetect" x="200" y="200" width="160" height="120">
  <properties>
    <property name="team" value="0"/>
    <property name="onlyWithTag" value="v08defender"/>
    <property name="minUnits" value="2"/>
    <property name="warmup" value="3s"/>
  </properties>
</object>

title.zh: 明确所有条件还是任一条件
title.en: Choose all conditions or any condition

body.zh: 增援对象的 activatedBy 连接时间和区域检测，allToActivate 设为 true 表示两者都要满足，repeatCount 为 1 表示最多激活一次，如果省略所有条件的要求，任意一条上游成立就可能提前触发
body.en: activatedBy connects the clock and detector to the reinforcement object, allToActivate true requires both and repeatCount one limits activation, omitting the all-condition requirement can allow either upstream event to trigger early

sections.code:
<object name="v08_reward" type="unitAdd" x="400" y="280" width="20" height="20">
  <properties>
    <property name="team" value="0"/>
    <property name="activatedBy" value="v08_clock,v08_zone"/>
    <property name="allToActivate" value="true"/>
    <property name="repeatCount" value="1"/>
    <property name="spawnUnits" value="rwa08Firecontrol*1,rwa08Skyguard*1"/>
  </properties>
</object>

title.zh: 按未满足和已满足分别观察

body.zh: 使用有效地图的副本，把配套 XML 对象合入 triggers 层，它不是独立地图，先只让时间满足，再只放一辆车，最后放入两辆并保持 3 秒，观察增援是否只出现一批，地图 XML 的 alsoActivate、activatedBy 与单位 INI 的动作引用属于两套连接规则
body.en: Merge the XML objects into the triggers layer of a valid map copy, the fragment is not a standalone map, observe time alone, then one vehicle, then two vehicles held for three seconds, map links and unit action references are separate systems

outcome.zh: 能画出两个条件汇合到一个结果的地图事件链
outcome.en: Draw a map event where two conditions feed one result

exercise.zh: 把人数要求改为 3，并把时间门槛改为 30 秒，写下哪些观察场景应当触发或不触发
exercise.en: Require three defenders and 30 seconds, then list cases that should and should not trigger

title.zh: 用两个阈值做稳定的应急状态

summary.zh: 把持续条件、状态记忆与恢复条件组合成简单状态机
summary.en: Combine periodic conditions, remembered state and a recovery threshold

title.zh: 先写两种状态和转换条件

body.zh: 战车有巡航与应急两种状态，生命低于 50% 进入应急，修复到 80% 才退出，两个不同阈值留出缓冲区，避免生命在临界值附近波动时反复切换
body.en: The tank has cruise and emergency states, it enters below 50% health and leaves after repair reaches 80%, separate thresholds prevent rapid toggling near a single boundary

sections.code:
巡航 / Cruise
  └─ HP < 50% → 应急 / Emergency
应急 / Emergency
  └─ HP ≥ 80% → 巡航 / Cruise

title.zh: 进入条件只在需要时成立

body.zh: not memory.emergency 让已经进入应急的单位不再重复执行进入动作，动作同时更新状态和速度，并发出一条可观察消息
body.en: not memory.emergency prevents the entry action from repeating while already in emergency mode, the action updates state and speed and emits an observable message

sections.code:
[hiddenAction_enterEmergency]
autoTrigger: if self.hp < self.maxHp * 0.5 and not memory.emergency
setUnitMemory: emergency=true
setUnitStats: movespeed=1.2
showMessageToPlayer: 应急模式开启 / Emergency mode enabled

title.zh: 恢复路径要单独写清楚

body.zh: 退出动作要求已经在应急状态且生命达到八成，恢复基础移动速度，不能只改布尔值却忘记还原之前修改的属性
body.en: The exit action requires emergency mode and at least 80% health, restore the original movement speed as well as the boolean state

sections.code:
[hiddenAction_leaveEmergency]
autoTrigger: if self.hp >= self.maxHp * 0.8 and memory.emergency
setUnitMemory: emergency=false
setUnitStats: movespeed=0.7
showMessageToPlayer: 已恢复巡航 / Cruise mode restored

title.zh: 测试完整循环与边界

body.zh: 依次观察 51%、49%、60%、81% 的生命状态，期望只在 49% 附近进入一次、81% 附近退出一次，再连续做两轮，检查消息、速度和弹种是否都恢复
body.en: Observe health near 51%, 49%, 60% and 81%, expect one entry near 49% and one exit near 81%, repeat the full cycle and inspect messages, speed and ammunition

outcome.zh: 得到一个不会在阈值附近频繁抖动的双状态单位
outcome.en: Create a two-state unit that avoids boundary oscillation

exercise.zh: 增加一张状态转换表，列出每次转换必须修改和恢复的所有数值
exercise.en: Make a transition table listing every value that must change and later reset

title.zh: 把复杂技能拆成可复用的小动作
title.en: Split a skill into reusable actions

summary.zh: 用命名调用组织逻辑，并避免循环调用与重复执行
summary.en: Organize logic with named action calls and avoid cycles and duplicate effects

title.zh: 让入口只负责转交任务

body.zh: 侦察车的开火事件先调用 record，record 再调用 increment，例子故意很小，便于理解入口和具体工作分开后，多个触发来源可以复用同一段计数逻辑
body.en: The recon firing event calls record, which calls increment, the example is deliberately small so you can see how multiple entry points can share the same underlying behavior

sections.code:
[turret_main]
onShoot_triggerActions: record

[hiddenAction_record]
alsoTriggerAction: increment

[hiddenAction_increment]
setUnitMemory: shots=memory.shots + 1

title.zh: 调用使用动作后缀

body.zh: alsoTriggerAction 写 increment，目标段落名是 hiddenAction_increment，为动作选择能表达用途的名字，例如 consumeEnergy、applyMode、reportState，比 a1、a2 更容易维护
body.en: alsoTriggerAction uses increment while the target section is hiddenAction_increment, names such as consumeEnergy, applyMode and reportState make a growing project easier to maintain

title.zh: 不要依赖同一动作中行的先后
title.en: Do not treat INI line order as program order

body.zh: 配置文件中的字段由游戏各自处理，不能仅凭把某一行移到前面就假定它先执行，当一个步骤必须读取另一步更新后的值时，拆开动作并验证调用结果
body.en: The game processes configuration fields by their own rules, moving a line upward does not establish execution order, split dependent steps into actions and verify the actual result

title.zh: 画调用图再检查循环

body.zh: 把触发入口画成箭头，例如开火 → record → increment，确保没有 increment 又调用 record 的回路，按钮报告只读取 shots，不应再增加计数
body.en: Draw the chain as fire → record → increment and make sure increment does not call back into record, the report button should read shots without increasing it

sections.code:
[action_report]
text: 查看射击统计 / Shot report
buildSpeed: 0
showMessageToPlayer: Shots: %{memory.shots}

outcome.zh: 能把一个流程拆成有明确职责的动作，并检查调用关系
outcome.en: Split behavior into focused actions and inspect the call graph

exercise.zh: 增加一次按钮触发的独立测试入口，确认它调用一次只增加一次
exercise.en: Add a separate test button and verify that one invocation increments exactly once

title.zh: 制作双炮塔战车并评估总火力
title.en: Build and balance a twin-turret vehicle

summary.zh: 处理两侧位置、共用弹体和多个炮塔带来的总输出
summary.en: Handle turret positions, a shared projectile and combined output

title.zh: 分别放置两个炮塔

body.zh: 双炮战车在中心左右各放一个炮塔，x 分别为 -7 和 7，y 保持 0，同一张炮塔图被重复使用，先检查炮塔是否落在底盘上
body.en: The twin tank places turrets at x:-7 and x:7 with y:0, both use the same turret image, check that each turret sits on the hull

sections.code:
[turret_main]
x: -7
y: 0
projectile: shell

[turret_second]
x: 7
y: 0
projectile: shell
delay: 1.2s

title.zh: 把弹体定义保留一份

body.zh: 两个炮塔都引用 shell，同一项伤害调整会影响两边，如果以后两侧武器不同，再拆成各自的弹体名称，初始版本先避免重复配置
body.en: Both turrets reference shell, so one damage change affects both, use separate projectile names later if the weapons diverge

sections.code:
[projectile_shell]
directDamage: 24
life: 1.5s
speed: 4
drawSize: 1
color: #FFE1B0

title.zh: 不要把两门炮当成一门计算

body.zh: 两门炮各自射击会提高总输出，造价和生命需要一起重新评估，示例没有设置严格交替开火，观察到齐射并不代表配置出错
body.en: Two firing turrets increase total output, review cost and durability together, this example does not enforce alternating fire so simultaneous shots are expected to be possible

title.zh: 检查拥挤与移动作战

body.zh: 在开阔地、狭窄地和移动追击三种场景测试，炮塔位置对视觉效果的影响会随转向变化，近距离目标可能更容易暴露炮口偏移问题
body.en: Test open ground, narrow paths and pursuit, the visual effect of offsets changes as the hull and turrets turn, close targets often reveal muzzle alignment problems

outcome.zh: 完成共享弹体的双炮单位，并按整车火力评估平衡
outcome.en: Create a twin-turret unit and balance total vehicle firepower

exercise.zh: 在相同造价预算下，比较两辆侦察车与一辆双炮车的实战结果
exercise.en: Compare two recon vehicles and one twin tank at similar total cost

title.zh: 让自己的单位成为地图增援
title.en: Use your units as map reinforcements

summary.zh: 将模组名称、地图对象和定时触发连接起来
summary.en: Connect mod unit names, map objects and timed triggers

title.zh: 在有效地图的副本上工作
title.en: Work on a copy of a valid map

body.zh: 项目内的 XML 是 triggers 对象组片段，不含地形和地图尺寸，先复制一张能够正常运行的 TMX 地图，再合并对象，已有 triggers 组时把对象放进原组中
body.en: The included XML is a triggers object-layer fragment without terrain or map dimensions, copy a working TMX map and merge the object into its existing triggers group

title.zh: 把增援写成地图对象

body.zh: unitAdd 表示生成单位，team:0 指定接收队伍，delay:10s 表示延迟，spawnUnits 中写单位内部名称和数量，坐标应放在队伍能到达的区域
body.en: unitAdd creates units, team:0 chooses the receiving team, delay:10s adds a delay and spawnUnits lists internal names with counts, choose a reachable location

sections.code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!-- 合并到已有地图的 triggers 对象组 / Merge into an existing map triggers layer -->
<objectgroup name="triggers">
  <object name="academy_reinforcements" type="unitAdd" x="200" y="200" width="20" height="20">
    <properties>
      <property name="team" value="0"/>
      <property name="delay" value="10s"/>
      <property name="repeatCount" value="1"/>
      <property name="spawnUnits" value="rwa06Recon*2,rwa06Twin*1"/>
      <property name="globalMessage" value="学院增援抵达 / Academy reinforcements arrived"/>
    </properties>
  </object>
</objectgroup>

title.zh: 同时检查队伍与模组依赖

body.zh: 地图运行时需要启用野战学院模组，也需要已经存在队伍 0，XML 语法正确但缺少单位或队伍时仍可能没有预期结果，先用沙盒确认三辆单位能够分别创建
body.en: Enable Field Academy when running the map and ensure team 0 exists, valid XML alone does not guarantee available units or teams, first confirm that all units can be spawned in the sandbox

title.zh: 用消息与数量验证触发

body.zh: 先观察 10 秒后的提示，再数清两辆侦察车和一辆双炮车，若提示出现但数量不对，检查单位名、生成位置和碰撞，若没有提示，再检查对象组与触发条件
body.en: Observe the message after ten seconds and count two recon vehicles plus one twin tank, if the message appears but units do not, inspect names and placement, if no message appears, inspect the layer and trigger conditions

outcome.zh: 将自定义单位接入完整地图，并用可观察信号定位问题
outcome.en: Integrate custom units into a complete map and use visible evidence to diagnose behavior

exercise.zh: 再增加一个 30 秒后抵达的增援对象，使用不同位置和对象名
exercise.en: Add a second reinforcement object at thirty seconds with a different name and location

title.zh: 用测试表判断一次改动值不值得
title.en: Use a test matrix to evaluate changes

summary.zh: 同时检查功能、平衡与多单位负载，把结果写得可复现
summary.en: Check functionality, balance and groups of units with reproducible notes

title.zh: 给每项功能一个预期
title.en: Write an expected result for each feature

body.zh: 自动模式项目至少检查出生状态、低生命进入、重复受伤、维修退出和再次进入，预期写成能观察的结果，例如只出现一条进入消息，而不是写感觉正常
body.en: For the adaptive project, test creation, low-health entry, continued damage, repaired exit and re-entry, write observable results such as one entry message rather than a vague pass

sections.code:
场景 / Case | 操作 / Action | 预期 / Expected
出生 / Spawn | 创建战车 / Create tank | 巡航速度 / Cruise speed
低血量 / Low HP | 降到 49% / Reduce to 49% | 进入一次 / Enter once
中间值 / Midrange | 修到 60% / Repair to 60% | 保持应急 / Stay in emergency
恢复 / Recover | 修到 81% / Repair to 81% | 回到巡航 / Return to cruise

title.zh: 保持对照条件一致

body.zh: 测试两种伤害参数时固定敌人、距离、数量和地形，记录游戏版本与模组版本，修改多个变量会让结果难以归因，先做单变量测试再评估整体玩法
body.en: Fix the enemy, distance, unit count and terrain when comparing damage settings, record game and mod versions, change one variable at a time before evaluating the whole design

title.zh: 从单车扩大到小队
title.en: Scale from one unit to a squad

body.zh: 一个自动动作正常不代表几十辆单位一起使用也合适，逐步测试 1、10、50 辆，观察消息是否刷屏和运行是否流畅，降低不必要的检查频率并减少重复动作
body.en: A behavior that works on one unit may be unsuitable for a large group, try 1, 10 and 50 units, check message spam and responsiveness and reduce unnecessary checks or repeated actions

title.zh: 把文件检查和游戏测试分别记录
title.en: Record file checks and game tests separately

body.zh: 文件检查可以发现缺图、错名与重复键，游戏测试才能确认实际行为，记录已完成的步骤与未测试项，遇到报错保留最早一条完整错误和能复现问题的最小文件
body.en: File checks catch missing art, wrong names and duplicate keys, in-game tests verify behavior, record completed and untested steps and retain the first full error with a minimal reproduction

outcome.zh: 拥有能被其他作者重复执行的测试清单
outcome.en: Produce a test checklist another author can repeat

exercise.zh: 为研究站的一次性升级再写一份余额、重复购买与多车独立性测试表
exercise.en: Write a matrix for research balance, repeated purchase and independent rover state

title.zh: 把练习整理成可维护的完整模组
title.en: Turn exercises into a maintainable mod

summary.zh: 整合工厂、单位、素材、教程与版本记录，再发布到代码仓库
summary.en: Organize factories, units, assets, tutorials and version notes before publishing

title.zh: 先整理单位名与文件名

body.zh: 综合项目统一使用 rwa06 前缀，文件名保持简短，内部名称与显示名称分别管理，合并其他练习时先检查重复资源名、动作名和复制路径，跨单位同名动作通常只是本单位范围，单位代号则必须保持清楚
body.en: The integrated project uses the rwa06 prefix and short file names, manage internal and display names separately, inspect resource IDs and copy paths when combining exercises, keep unit identifiers unambiguous

title.zh: 把工厂作为玩家入口
title.en: Use the factory as the player entry point

body.zh: 训练厂把两辆车列成清楚的生产选项，菜单位置按用途排列，工厂本身当前从沙盒创建，若加入正式对局，还要给玩家已有工程单位增加建造入口并完成相应测试
